description: Record a shared expense, split equally. paid_by defaults to the person you act for; split_among defaults to everyone in the plan. Always confirm the amount and who shares it with the user first.

allow_duplicate.description: Only if the user confirms a second, identical expense within 10 minutes (otherwise it is treated as a retry).

amount.description: Total, max 2 decimals (e.g. 42.5). Send a plain number.

currency.description: ISO code, e.g. CZK or EUR. Sets the plan's currency if it has no expenses yet; otherwise must match it (see get_plan currency).

description.description: What it was for, e.g. "Groceries" (max 120 chars).

paid_by_participant_id.description: Who paid (participant_id from get_plan, or their exact name). Defaults to you.

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character id. Bare module links such as https://lesgooo.fun/when are local drafts: ask for a saved link, never substitute a previous plan ID.

split_among.description: Who shares the cost (participant_id values or exact names). Defaults to everyone.

name: add_expense
title: Add an expense
